chapter: Heroes, heard bands and Lunceford's life on the road
title: How drummers learned their craft
summary: Crawford says drummers either had it or not, and he did not hang out with other drummers.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Well, how did -- how did drummers learn their craft in those days, or did they -- I mean --
Either you had it or you didn't. That was their only way of learning and playing drums. Either you have it or you had it or you didn't. Then you'd just be another drummer.
Well, that's not so much what I mean. I mean how did -- I mean like -- I mean did drummers -- I mean did drummers hang out together and practice things together or did they (unintelligible)?
Well, maybe some did, but I didn't.
I didn't hang out with drummers. I was out there over the bars or all that. The other drummers were out over the bars too. I don't know how Sonny Greer got his knowledge, but he just played himself.
